name: 07849 · Lk Hopatcong, NJ
findings: ZIP 07849 (Lk Hopatcong) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07849 (Lk Hopatcong) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
